getPageContent.name: getPageContent
getPageContent.description: Get page content and optionally all its descendants

pageId.description: Get this from the page URL of your Confluence Cloud

includeDescendants.description: If checked, will fetch all child pages recursively.

auth.description: Please refer to this guide to get your api credentials: https://support.atlassian.com/atlassian-account/docs/manage-api-tokens-for-your-atlassian-account

aiMetadata.description: Fetches a single Confluence page (title and storage-format body) by its page ID; when "include descendants" is enabled it additionally walks the page tree and returns child pages recursively up to a configurable max depth. Use to read the full content of a known page, optionally including its sub-pages. Requires the numeric page ID (from the page URL); read-only and idempotent.

get-page-by-url.name: get-page-by-url
get-page-by-url.description: Fetches a page by its Confluence web URL (extracts the page ID automatically).

url.description: Paste any Confluence page URL, e.g. https://your-domain.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DOCS/pages/12345/My+Page

aiMetadata.description: Fetches a single Confluence page when you have its web URL rather than its numeric ID, parsing the page ID out of the URL automatically. Use instead of Get Page Content when the agent only has a copy-pasted page link. The body representation (storage, view, atlas doc, or none) is selectable. Read-only and idempotent.

find-page-by-title.name: find-page-by-title
find-page-by-title.description: Finds a page by exact title, optionally scoped to a space.

auth.description: Please refer to this guide to get your api credentials: https://support.atlassian.com/atlassian-account/docs/manage-api-tokens-for-your-atlassian-account

aiMetadata.description: Looks up Confluence pages by exact title, optionally restricted to one space, returning matches plus a found flag and count. Use to resolve a page title to its ID before reading or updating it. Match is exact (not fuzzy); for keyword or broader queries use Search Content (CQL) instead. Read-only and idempotent.

search-pages.name: search-pages
search-pages.description: Search Confluence content with CQL (Confluence Query Language). Example: `type = "page" AND space = "DOCS" AND title ~ "release"`.

expand.description: Comma-separated list of properties to expand (e.g. `body.storage,version,space,history`).

aiMetadata.description: Searches Confluence content using a CQL (Confluence Query Language) expression, paginating until the max-results cap is reached. Use for flexible, multi-criteria or keyword search across pages/blogposts/comments (by type, space, title, label, date, text); use Find Page by Title for exact-title lookups instead. Requires a valid CQL string. Read-only and idempotent.

create-page.name: create-page
create-page.description: Creates a new page in a space with the given title and body.

auth.description: Please refer to this guide to get your api credentials: https://support.atlassian.com/atlassian-account/docs/manage-api-tokens-for-your-atlassian-account
Please refer to this guide to get your api credentials: https://support.atlassian.com/atlassian-account/docs/manage-api-tokens-for-your-atlassian-account

body.description: Page content in the selected format.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new Confluence page in the given space with a title and body, optionally nested under a parent page, and either published (current) or saved as a draft. The body is interpreted in the chosen format (storage XHTML, wiki markup, or atlas doc format). Use to author a brand-new page. Not idempotent: each call creates another page even with identical input.

create-page-from-template.name: create-page-from-template
create-page-from-template.description: Creates a new page from a template with the given title and variables.

auth.description: Please refer to this guide to get your api credentials: https://support.atlassian.com/atlassian-account/docs/manage-api-tokens-for-your-atlassian-account

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new Confluence page by fetching a template, substituting its declared variables with the provided values, and posting the rendered content as a page (published or draft) in the given space. Use when a page should follow a predefined template rather than free-form body. Requires the template ID and matching variable names. Not idempotent: each call creates another page.

update-page.name: update-page
update-page.description: Updates the title, body, or status of an existing page.

auth.description: Please refer to this guide to get your api credentials: https://support.atlassian.com/atlassian-account/docs/manage-api-tokens-for-your-atlassian-account
Please refer to this guide to get your api credentials: https://support.atlassian.com/atlassian-account/docs/manage-api-tokens-for-your-atlassian-account

title.description: Leave blank to keep the current title.

body.description: New page content. Leave blank to keep existing body.

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing Confluence page identified by page ID, changing its title, body, and/or status; blank title or body fields keep the current values. Reads the current version first and bumps the version number on save. Use to edit a known page. Not strictly idempotent: each call increments the page version even when content is unchanged.

delete-page.name: delete-page
delete-page.description: Trashes or permanently deletes a page.

auth.description: Please refer to this guide to get your api credentials: https://support.atlassian.com/atlassian-account/docs/manage-api-tokens-for-your-atlassian-account
Please refer to this guide to get your api credentials: https://support.atlassian.com/atlassian-account/docs/manage-api-tokens-for-your-atlassian-account

purge.description: If enabled, the page is removed from the trash permanently. Otherwise it is moved to trash.

aiMetadata.description: Deletes a Confluence page by ID; by default it is moved to the trash, or when "purge permanently" is enabled it is removed from the trash for good. Use to remove a page. Not idempotent in practice: it mutates page state and re-running after deletion errors rather than returning the same result, and a purge is irreversible.

move-page.name: move-page
move-page.description: Moves a page to a new parent as a child, sibling, or to the top of the parent.

auth.description: Please refer to this guide to get your api credentials: https://support.atlassian.com/atlassian-account/docs/manage-api-tokens-for-your-atlassian-account
Please refer to this guide to get your api credentials: https://support.atlassian.com/atlassian-account/docs/manage-api-tokens-for-your-atlassian-account

options.label: Append as last child of target
Insert as first child of target

targetPageId.description: The page to move relative to. Use "append" or "before" to nest under it, "after" to place as sibling.

aiMetadata.description: Repositions a Confluence page in the content tree relative to a target page: append/insert it as a child of the target, or place it as a sibling after the target. Use to re-parent or reorder a page. Requires the page ID and the target page ID. Effectively idempotent — re-running with the same position and target leaves the page in the same place.

publish-draft.name: publish-draft
publish-draft.description: Publishes a draft page (changes status from draft to current).

pageId.description: ID of the draft page to publish.

aiMetadata.description: Publishes an existing draft Confluence page by ID, flipping its status from draft to current while preserving its title and body. Use to make a previously created draft live. Requires the draft page ID. Effectively idempotent once published — re-running on an already-current page leaves it published.

add-comment.name: add-comment
add-comment.description: Adds a footer comment to a page.

auth.description: Please refer to this guide to get your api credentials: https://support.atlassian.com/atlassian-account/docs/manage-api-tokens-for-your-atlassian-account
Please refer to this guide to get your api credentials: https://support.atlassian.com/atlassian-account/docs/manage-api-tokens-for-your-atlassian-account

body.description: Comment body in storage (XHTML) format. Plain text works too.

aiMetadata.description: Posts a new footer comment on a Confluence page, with the comment body given in storage (XHTML) format (plain text is accepted). Use to leave a top-level comment on a page; to respond to an existing comment use Reply to Comment instead. Not idempotent: each call adds another comment.

reply-to-comment.name: reply-to-comment
reply-to-comment.description: Replies to an existing footer comment on a page.

parentCommentId.description: The ID of the comment to reply to.

aiMetadata.description: Posts a reply nested under an existing footer comment, identified by the parent comment ID, with the reply body in storage (XHTML) format. Use to respond in a comment thread; to start a new top-level comment use Add Comment to Page instead. Not idempotent: each call adds another reply.

list-comments.name: list-comments
list-comments.description: Lists footer and/or inline comments on a page.

auth.description: Please refer to this guide to get your api credentials: https://support.atlassian.com/atlassian-account/docs/manage-api-tokens-for-your-atlassian-account
Please refer to this guide to get your api credentials: https://support.atlassian.com/atlassian-account/docs/manage-api-tokens-for-your-atlassian-account

aiMetadata.description: Lists comments on a Confluence page; a comment-type selector controls whether it returns footer comments, inline comments, or both (fetched separately and returned under footer/inline keys). Body representation (storage, view, or atlas doc) is selectable. Use to read or enumerate a page's comments. Read-only and idempotent.

upload-attachment.name: upload-attachment
upload-attachment.description: Uploads a file as an attachment to a page.

auth.description: Please refer to this guide to get your api credentials: https://support.atlassian.com/atlassian-account/docs/manage-api-tokens-for-your-atlassian-account
Please refer to this guide to get your api credentials: https://support.atlassian.com/atlassian-account/docs/manage-api-tokens-for-your-atlassian-account

comment.description: Optional comment associated with this attachment version.

minorEdit.description: If enabled, no notifications are sent to page watchers.

aiMetadata.description: Uploads a file as an attachment on a Confluence page via multipart form upload, with an optional version comment and a minor-edit flag to suppress watcher notifications. Use to attach a document or image to a page. Requires the page ID and the file. Uploading the same filename again creates a new version rather than a duplicate, but each call still mutates state, so treat as not idempotent.

download-attachment.name: download-attachment
download-attachment.description: Downloads an attachment file by its ID and returns it as a file.

attachmentId.description: ID of the attachment to download. Use "List Attachments" to look up IDs.

aiMetadata.description: Downloads a Confluence attachment by its attachment ID, resolving the download link from the attachment metadata and returning the binary as a file plus the attachment details. Use to retrieve the actual file contents of an attachment (use List Attachments first to discover IDs). Read-only and idempotent.

list-attachments.name: list-attachments
list-attachments.description: Lists all attachments on a page.

auth.description: Please refer to this guide to get your api credentials: https://support.atlassian.com/atlassian-account/docs/manage-api-tokens-for-your-atlassian-account
Please refer to this guide to get your api credentials: https://support.atlassian.com/atlassian-account/docs/manage-api-tokens-for-your-atlassian-account

aiMetadata.description: Lists the attachments on a Confluence page, returning their metadata including IDs. Use to enumerate a page's files or to find an attachment ID to feed into Download Attachment. Requires the page ID. Read-only and idempotent.

add-label.name: add-label
add-label.description: Adds one or more labels to a page.

auth.description: Please refer to this guide to get your api credentials: https://support.atlassian.com/atlassian-account/docs/manage-api-tokens-for-your-atlassian-account
Please refer to this guide to get your api credentials: https://support.atlassian.com/atlassian-account/docs/manage-api-tokens-for-your-atlassian-account

labels.description: Label names to add (one per row).

aiMetadata.description: Adds one or more labels to a Confluence page, with a selectable prefix (global, personal/my, or team) applied to all labels in the call. Use to tag or categorize a page. Requires the page ID and at least one label name. Effectively idempotent — re-adding an existing label leaves the page's label set unchanged.

remove-label.name: remove-label
remove-label.description: Removes a label from a page.

auth.description: Please refer to this guide to get your api credentials: https://support.atlassian.com/atlassian-account/docs/manage-api-tokens-for-your-atlassian-account
Please refer to this guide to get your api credentials: https://support.atlassian.com/atlassian-account/docs/manage-api-tokens-for-your-atlassian-account

aiMetadata.description: Removes a single label, by name, from a Confluence page. Use to untag a page. Requires the page ID and the label name. Effectively idempotent — re-running after the label is gone leaves the page's label set unchanged.

find-user.name: find-user
find-user.description: Looks up Confluence users by name, email, or keyword.

keyword.description: Username, email, or display name to search for.

aiMetadata.description: Searches Confluence users by a keyword matched against full name and username (via CQL), returning matching user records plus a found flag and count. Use to resolve a person's name or email to a Confluence user/account ID. Read-only and idempotent.

list-spaces.name: list-spaces
list-spaces.description: Lists all spaces the authenticated user can access.

aiMetadata.description: Lists the Confluence spaces the authenticated user can access (paginated through all results), optionally filtered by space type (global, personal, collaboration, knowledge base) and status (current or archived). Use to discover available spaces or resolve a space to its ID. Read-only and idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

pt.Get this from the page URL of your Confl: Obter isto na URL da página de sua Nuvem de Confluência
pt.If checked, will fetch all child pages r: Se marcado, irá buscar todas as páginas filhas recursivamente.
pt.Paste any Confluence page URL, e.g. http: Cole qualquer URL da página de Confluência, por exemplo, https://your-domain.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DOCS/pages/12345/My+Page
pt.Confluence Query Language expression. Se: Expressão de Consulta de Confluência. Veja https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/confluence/advanced-searching-using-cql/
pt.Comma-separated list of properties to ex: Lista de propriedades separadas por vírgulas para expandir (por exemplo, `body.storage,version,espaço,history`).
Conteúdo da página no formato selecionado.
Deixe em branco para manter o título atual.
pt.New page content. Leave blank to keep ex: Novo conteúdo da página. Deixe em branco para manter o corpo existente.
pt.If enabled, the page is removed from the: Se habilitado, a página será removida da lixeira permanentemente. Caso contrário, será movido para a lixeira.
pt.The page to move relative to. Use \"appe: A página para mover relativo para. Use "acrescentar" ou "antes" para aninhar embaixo dela, "após" para colocar como irmão.
ID da página rascunho para publicar.
Comentar corpo do comentário no formato de armazenamento (XHTML). Texto simples também funciona.
A identificação do comentário a que responder.
Responder corpo no formato de armazenamento (XHTML).
pt.Optional comment associated with this at: Comentário opcional associado a esta versão anexada.
pt.If enabled, no notifications are sent to: Se ativado, nenhuma notificação será enviada aos observadores de páginas.
pt.ID of the attachment to download. Use \": ID do anexo para download. Use "Listar Anexos" para procurar IDs.
Nomes de etiquetas para adicionar (um por linha).
pt.Username, email, or display name to sear: Nome de usuário, e-mail ou nome de exibição para procurar.
pt.Authorization headers are injected autom: Os cabeçalhos de autorização são inseridos automaticamente a partir da sua conexão.
Habilitar para arquivos como PDFs, imagens, etc.
pt.Append as last child of target: Acrescentar como último filho do alvo
pt.Insert as first child of target: Inserir como primeiro filho do alvo
pt.HEAD: CABEÇA
Dispara quando uma nova página é criada.
pt.Triggers when an existing page is update: Aciona quando uma página existente é atualizada (versão > 1).
pt.Triggers when a new footer comment is ad: Dispara quando um novo comentário de rodapé é adicionado à página selecionada.
pt.Triggers when a new attachment is upload: Dispara quando um novo anexo é carregado para a página selecionada.
pt.Triggers when a new blog post is publish: Dispara quando um novo post é publicado no espaço selecionado.
